Blackbook — Lower GI bleed แยกตามสาเหตุ

Occult Bleeding (or iron-deficiency anemia)

  • Colorectal cancer
  • Angiodysplasia (colon or small bowel)
  • Occult UGIB (ulcer, esophagitis, gastritis, cancer)
  • Small bowel tumors
  • Asymptomatic IBD

Overt Bleeding — Out Patient

  • Perianal disease most common (hemorrhoids, fissures, abscess)
  • Inflammatory Bowel Disease
  • Colorectal Cancer

Overt Bleeding — In Patient (lots of bleeding; rule out brisk UGIB): Large Bowel - Painful

  • Acute colitis (ischemia, infectious, inflammatory)

Overt Bleeding — In Patient: Large Bowel - Painless

  • Diverticular bleed
  • Angiodysplasia

Overt Bleeding — In Patient: Small Bowel

  • Meckel’s Diverticulum
  • Tumors
